events.text: You arrive as the morning’s work begins. Walk, meet someone, or find your own way.
You drink cool water and refill your vessel.
Reed: “There is room beside the hearth. You may visit plastered household for the next few hours.”
Reed accepts: 1 obsidian flakes for 1 grain.
You return to the open air.
You take the contents of storage vessel.
Reed saw you take property belonging to the household.
You return the goods you still carry.
Reed agrees to your company on the way to work. The invitation lasts ten minutes.
You catch the lizard. It is now in your possession.
You gather ripe grain. The harvested plot remains bare.
You guide the sheep toward its enclosure. Open the gate to let it through.
